character: World's largest cross-border ski area — 600km marketed, 12 French and Swiss villages, 2 countries, 1 pass. Home of the Swiss Wall.
description: One of the largest international ski areas in the world — 650km of pistes, 196 lifts, linking 12 resorts across France and Switzerland (Avoriaz, Morzine, Les Gets, Châtel, Abondance, La Chapelle, Montriond, St-Jean-d'Aulps, Morgins, Champéry, Champoussin, Les Crosets). 150km of Swiss runs. Known for: cross-border skiing (passport not needed within domain), Avoriaz (car-free, futuristic, horse-drawn transport), Morzine (traditional market town, valley base), Les Gets (family-friendly), Châtel (lively farming village), and Morgins/Champéry (Swiss side charm). The domain stretches from the Dranse valley to the Swiss Valais. Snow-sure above 1,600m.

weather_snow.microclimate: Between Lake Geneva and Mont Blanc — moisture-laden systems
weather_snow.snow_reliability: 7/10 — Avoriaz (1,800m) most reliable, Swiss side lower altitude closes earlier

iconic_run: Swiss Wall (Chavanette) — legendary steep, ungroomed black run
key_facts: Largest cross-border ski area in the Alps
5 disconnected piste networks, not one single connected area
Les Gets + Morzine Pleney is a separate network via shuttle
Geneva 80 km — one of the most accessible large domains from a major airport
name: Portes du Soleil

lift_pass_pricing.note: Portes du Soleil pass includes both French and Swiss sides. Avoriaz-only pass also available. Cross-border pass recommended for staying more than 2 days.

suitability.beginners: Excellent — Les Gets beginners area (Chavannes), Avoriaz nursery slopes at 1,800m, Morzine's Pleney sector. Swiss side Morgins has gentle greens.
suitability.intermediates: World-class for intermediates — 650km of mainly blue and red runs. The Swiss side (Champéry, Morgins) has long, gentle valley runs back to village. The French side has more challenging reds.
suitability.advanced: Good — Swiss Wall (Wall de la Ratache), Avoriaz's Chavanette/Lindarets area. The Hauts-Forts face. St-Jean-d'Aulps Roc d'Enfer.
suitability.families: One of the best family domains in the world. Avoriaz car-free (horse-drawn carriages), Aquariaz tropical spa, 10+ toboggan runs, kids clubs. Les Gets has an activities lake and golf course in summer. Morzine has full town services all year.
